cohort: Pregnant women divided into four groups: spontaneous pregnancies, pregnancies achieved after mild ovarian ovulation induction without ART, pregnancies after mild ovarian stimulation and ART procedures, and pregnancies after multi-follicular stimulation with gonadotropin therapy and ART procedures
finding: Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) was associated with higher rates of pregnancy-induced hypertension, and assisted reproductive technology (ART) procedures after mild mono/bi follicular ovarian stimulation were associated with more fetal macrosomia.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean section differed among the groups (21.8%, 37.2%, 21.7%, and 17.6% in groups A, B, C and D respectively, p=0.048).
